preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call setMultipliers function
Contract must have trading enabled (tradingOpen = true)
Attacker must hold some LUNAINU tokens to execute trades

exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call setMultipliers with buyMultiplier = 0 to trigger division by zero in takeFee function. This will cause feeAmount calculation to revert, allowing tax-free trading. Then execute buy/sell trades to profit from the tax bypass while other users still pay fees. The division occurs in: feeAmount = amount.mul(totalFee).mul(multiplier).div(feeDenominator * 100) where multiplier can be zero.
